sources.locator: "Partial Nuclear Test Ban Treaty", revision 1375345300, § Effects

explanation: The English article on the test ban states the relation and says the later treaty states it too: "The PTBT has been considered the stepping stone to the Treaty on the Non-Proliferation of Nuclear Weapons (NPT) of 1968, which explicitly referred to the progress provided by the PTBT." The edge claims that and no more; the article attributes the reading rather than asserting it, which is why it is probable.
